To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the future of agricultural automation is in: (1) the application of a new set of technologies to the crop system; (2) the application of these technologies at the right time, in the right way; (3) the application of the right technologies to the right crops; (4) the use of a range of different technologies; (5) the use of the right technologies in the right places; (6) the use of technologies that can be applied at the right time; and
there are many ways to service the agronomy of a crop, and that the way forward is to find a way to do this that is more effective and less costly than current practice.
there are many ways to support the crop production process and the most efficient way to do this may not be the way we currently do it.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of technologies to support agricultural production in a sustainable manner, with a particular focus on the development of autonomous systems that can operate in a crop field environment.

the design of a new generation of agricultural machines that will be more effective in terms of agronomic performance and economic efficiency, more flexible in terms of their use, more adaptable in terms of their application, and more environmentally friendly in terms of their impact on the soil, water, and atmosphere.
the development of a new generation of technologies that can be used to improve agricultural productivity and sustainability, and to reduce the environmental impact of farming.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there are now many new ways to support the crop and that we need to be open to these opportunities and to be prepared to try them.
there are many opportunities to use automation to improve agricultural productivity, efficiency, sustainability, safety and profitability.
we do not know what the most effective and efficient ways to carry out agriculture are and we need to experiment with many concepts before we find out.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we need to think differently about how we do agriculture, not just in terms of the technology but in terms of the agronomic requirements that we need the technology to support.
there are now opportunities for new ways of doing things that will allow us to be more effective, more efficient, and more sustainable.
we have a number of concepts that can be used to improve the productivity, efficiency, and effectiveness of agricultural systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the future of agriculture will not be a continuation of the present but a transformation.
there is no one-size-fits-all solution.
we need to be more creative and innovative in our approach to agriculture.
